headline: MilDef Group Reports Record Third-Quarter Sales and Operating Profit
summary: Tactical IT hardware manufacturer MilDef Group delivered record sales and profit growth in the third quarter of 2026.
why: MilDef produces rugged computers and tactical electronics for military and defense applications, a sector seeing elevated European defense spending.

impacts.name: MilDef Group AB
impacts.why: Record earnings performance reflects strengthening European defense technology demand.
